name: Instant Knowledge Base – Documentation, FAQs, & Help Center
author: Seventh Sky

sections.description:
Instant Knowledge Base helps you launch a modern self-service help center in minutes, perfect for product docs, SaaS onboarding, internal SOPs, and FAQs. It includes a clean UI, AJAX live search, FAQ schema for rich results, role-based access, and flexible templates. Reduce tickets, improve CSAT, and keep answers consistent across your site.

Highlights

  • AJAX live search & filters for instant results.
  • Custom post type for structured articles plus Help Topics (categories).
  • FAQ system with Google FAQ schema for SEO-friendly snippets.
  • Role-based access (global + per-article overrides).
  • Related & most-viewed articles, breadcrumbs, and icons for topics.
  • Fully responsive and theme-friendly.
  • Shortcode to embed anywhere: [instant_knowledgebase].

Why it’s different

  • Built for speed and clarity (reduces support friction).
  • Thoughtful privacy/GDPR controls (analytics respect consent).
  • Templates for home, category, and single views; additional layouts are available in the separate Pro add-on.

⭐ WALK-THROUGH: Instant Knowledge Base Tutorial

Learn how to install, activate, and configure your knowledge base with our easy step-by-step guide.

Knowledge Base Features

  • Unlimited KB Articles: Create an unlimited number of KB articles
  • Unlimited FAQs: Create Modern & SEO Schema FAQs
  • Modern, responsive layout
  • Floating Widget with Search option (optional)
  • Custom post type for Knowledge Base Articles
  • Help Topics (categories) + hierarchy
  • Typography (Google Fonts):
  • Real-time AJAX search and filters
  • Unified Shortcode: [instant_knowledgebase]
  • Related and Most Viewed articles
  • Like/Dislike feedback
  • Breadcrumbs and topic icons
  • Role-based access (global + per-article)
  • Category visibility controls & empty-category options
  • Custom article & Help Topic ordering for a structured homepage and categories

Go PRO for additional features

  • Layout Designs: 4+ professionally designed layouts you can instantly switch between and customize to match your brand.
  • Advanced analytics dashboard: Track searched keywords, missing content, engagement, and article performance to optimize your KB.
  • Conversion Funnels & Automated Insights: Identify drop-off points, user intent, and improvement opportunities with smart automated insights.
  • Advanced search UI: Includes dropdown search, live suggestions, instant search results, and more.
  • Hero section builder: Customize your KB hero section, with colors, backgrounds, animations, and advanced options.
  • Interactive checklists: Add interactive checklists or single checkboxes inside articles for tutorials and workflows.
  • PDF export: Export articles or full analytics reports with one click.
  • KB Widget Add your knowledge base anywhere using the [ikbase_widget] shortcode. Give users quick search access with live, dropdown results right inside the page they’re on.
  • Video Section Add video/tutorial section for the demo videos
  • Product sections & landing: Multiple product lines, product-scoped help topics, and an optional product picker before the main knowledge base.

sections.installation:
You can install the Instant Knowledgebase plugin in three ways:

Automatic

  1. In Plugins → Add New, search for Instant Knowledge Base.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Upload

  1. Download the ZIP.
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Upload the ZIP, Install Now, then Activate
sections.faq:
How do I display the knowledge base on my site?

Use the [instant_knowledgebase] shortcode on any WordPress page or post to display the knowledge base.

Can I restrict access to certain users?

Yes. You can enable user-role restrictions from Settings > Knowledge Base to control who can view articles.

Is this plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, it is fully responsive and optimized for smartphones and tablets.

Can I customize the look and feel?

Absolutely. You can apply custom CSS or override the plugin’s templates to match your site’s branding.

Does it include article analytics?

Yes. Built-in view counters, like/dislike feedback system, and comprehensive analytics dashboard help track user engagement.

Can I import or export articles?

Yes. The plugin includes import/export functionality for easy backup and transfer of knowledge base content.

Does this plugin support FAQs?

Yes. From v1.0.5, you can enable a dedicated FAQ system with schema markup for SEO.

Can I hide certain categories?

Yes. Categories can be hidden or shown on the frontend from category settings (new in 1.0.5).

Can I hide empty categories?

Yes. There’s a global option in Basic Settings to show/hide empty help topics.

Does it include analytics?

Yes. The free plugin includes basic counters, feedback, and admin analytics summaries. Advanced analytics, funnels, and external integrations (GA4, Mixpanel) are provided by the separate Pro add-on.

Can I use the widget anywhere?

The KB widget shortcode ([ikbase_widget]) is provided by the separate Pro add-on.

Can I change the terms “Articles” and “Categories”?

Yes. You can rename “Articles” to “Knowledge Base” and “Categories” to “Help Topics” in the settings.

How do I organize articles?

Articles can be grouped using help topics (formerly categories) for better organization and navigation.

Can I control access per article?

Yes. You can set access permissions globally or override them on a per-article basis.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin provides options to retain or remove data, giving you more control during uninstallation.

What analytics features are available?

The free plugin includes view counts, feedback, and admin analytics summaries. Advanced analytics and exports are provided by the separate Pro add-on.

Can I use custom fonts?

Yes. The free plugin supports core typography settings. Additional typography options (including more Google Fonts controls) are provided by the separate Pro add-on.

Are there premium templates available?

Yes. Additional layouts (Help Center Modern, Opt-in Focus v2, Content Focus, etc.) are provided by the separate Pro add-on.
